text:
Cutter Gauthier is having the kind of month people write about for years. Three hat tricks in five games, goals in six straight, 13 goals in his last ten, and 15 on the season through 17 games. Anaheim is winning with it: the Ducks took six of those last seven.

Here is the honest split. The chances are earned: he is getting 1.67 expected goals per 60 on his own shots, up from 1.36, his ice time is up almost two minutes over the hot stretch, and he is on for 87% of the power play. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 99th percentile last season at getting to the home-plate area in front of the net. The finishing is not: 15 goals on 8.7 expected, a 21% shooting rate against 14% last season.

So the goals will slow, but the shooter is the real thing. Even after regression our projection lands him around 54 goals. His five-on-five share (41% of expected goals with him on) is the part to fix.
headline: Gauthier's hat-trick run is real, mostly
